notes: AATC is a 45% associate, so its 15 student outreach programmes are counted only as a supporting level-2 record. The SG60 SIA Cares campaign for youth with disabilities was considered for Cross-cultural but kept under Community only, since it is charitable fundraising rather than an access or connecting practice; picked the lower level when torn. KrisWorld content licensing from large studios was treated as a routine input, not enabling creators (borderline). The Future Skills for Leaders framework (including Inclusive Leadership and Storytelling) is planned, with rollout 'in the next two years', so it is not counted. 'The Art of Singapore Airlines Cargo' is a marketing campaign (trap). Directors' personal roles at arts and education bodies are not company activities. The Singapore Airlines Academy chapter is listed in the contents but its text was not provided. The Kris+ payment/marketing subsidiary has no detail on small-merchant enabling.
